candidates.source_name: Ephrem the Syrian / Commentary on Exodus
candidates.source_attribution: Ephrem the Syrian, Commentary on Exodus XXVIII.12 (NPNF S2 V13, Gwynn/Schaff trans., Oxford 1898). PD.
candidates.draft_body:
Ephrem the Syrian Commentary on Exodus (c. 360 AD)

The plate of pure gold on the high priest's forehead, engraved 'Holiness to the Lord' — Ephrem reads this as the priestly title borne by the high priest in figure and by Christ in fulfilment: the True Priest carries the holiness of the Lord on his very person, not as an ornament but as his essence. Tewahedo priestly vestments retain the canonical pattern of the Aaronic mitre as a deliberate iconographic echo.
